artworks.title: Holy Family with Saints
artworks.artist: Jan de Bisschop, after Giorgio Vasari
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a detailed drawing of multiple people in a classical setting. A woman is seated in the center, holding a small child on her lap. She is shown from the waist up, with her head slightly bowed and eyes downcast. The child is prominently positioned, mostly unclothed, and depicted in a dynamic pose with arms extended. Surrounding them are four other figures, each dressed in flowing robes. They have bearded faces and curly hair. One figure stands to the left with his hand raised to his chest. Behind the central group are massive pillars leading to an elaborate background with architectural elements. In the foreground, there is a cushion and an open book.

artworks.title: Ennio Quirino Visconti
artworks.medium: etching with burin and stipple
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a man seated and facing slightly to his right. He has prominent eyes, a slightly open mouth, and wavy hair that falls to his ears. He is wearing a high-collared, buttoned jacket. There is no visible jewelry or other objects in his hands. The background is a textured oval frame, which isolates the bust from the plain surface surrounding it. The name “Ennio Quirino Visconti” and the title “Console della Repubblica Romana” are inscribed beneath the image alongside the name "Cecchini incise."

artworks.title: Pope Urban VIII
artworks.medium: engraving and stipple on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man with distinctive facial features, wearing a cap and an ornate robe. The background is plain, with text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Gianlorenzo Bernini
artworks.medium: engraving and stipple on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with short wavy hair, a mustache, sharp facial features, and a calm expression. He is wearing a detailed garment with a high lace collar, a vest or coat with visible stitching and buttons, and a cross pendant. The background has fine lines, an ornate octagonal border, and text identifying him as "Eques Joan's Laurentius," a sculptor.

artworks.title: Gabriello Chiabrera
artworks.medium: engraving and stipple in laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 14.5 × 11.4 cm (5 11/16 × 4 1/2 in.) [trimmed to plate]
mount: 18.5 × 14 cm (7 5/16 × 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This image features an engraved bust portrait of a man. He is shown from the chest up, facing slightly to his right with a solemn expression. He has prominent eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a pointed nose, and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair is short and combed back, revealing a high forehead. He is wearing a dark, buttoned doublet with a large lace ruff around his neck. The background includes an oval frame with engraved text around the border.

artworks.title: Francesco Paolo da Pesaro
artworks.medium: engraving and stipple on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicting his head and shoulders. The man is positioned facing slightly to the side, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has a calm expression, thick eyebrows, and a neatly groomed mustache and goatee. His hair is full, wavy, and pulled back from his face. He is wearing a garment with a high, white collar and intricate patterned detail on the chest. The background is a simple, oval frame with text inscribed around the edges. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Ennio Quirino Visconti
artworks.artist: Luigi Rados, after Luigi Bramati or Antonio Bramati
artworks.medium: etching and stipple engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his body facing slightly to the side and his head turned towards the viewer. He has short, curly hair and defined facial features. He is wearing a dark jacket with buttons, a shirt with a high collar, and a medal or insignia. In the room, there is a table with round artifacts or coins, a bookcase filled with books, relief sculptures on the wall, and classical sculptures, including a statue of a muscular male figure.

artworks.title: Marchese Cesare Beccaria
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio Sasso, after G. B. Bosio
artworks.medium: etching and stipple engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man in ornate clothing from the knees up, facing slightly left. He is styled in 18th-century attire with a detailed, embroidered jacket over a brocade vest and knee-length breeches. He has a round face and composed expression with side curls hairstyle. He sits on a decorated chair, holding a quill in his left hand. The background includes a draped curtain and a table with a book.

artworks.title: Gaetano Filangieri
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio Sasso, after G. B. Bosio
artworks.medium: etching and stipple engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man sitting, looking calm with one arm on rocky surface and the other holding a small book. He has notable features like eyes, nose, and mouth. His hair is styled back, and he is dressed in a long overcoat with fur trim over a ruffled shirt. The man wears shoes with buckles and there is foliage in the background suggesting an outdoor setting. Underneath the image, the name "Gaetano Filangieri" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Oaks along the Appian Way near Albano
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle. A pathway leads towards the center with dense trees and a large rock formation obscuring the horizon. The artwork features delicate pencil strokes capturing the texture of foliage and rocks with shading. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and black on a white background. The terrain closest to us is undulating with sparse vegetation and rocks. In the distance, the path winds through the landscape towards man-made structures partially covered by nature.

artworks.title: The Eye Deceived
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper with hand coloring
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an arrangement of printed and illustrated materials. The composition features a variety of printed papers overlapping each other, with illustrations of various scenes and characters. Prominently displayed is a large piece of paper titled "ROGER'S Delight," accompanied by smaller images of historical and possibly mythological figures in colorful attire. In the center, an illustration of a nude figure within a cave. Other vignettes include a detailed portrait of a woman in an oval frame, and a piece of paper that advertises services for design, engraving, and illustration by Sutton Nicholls. The imagery contains a mix of text and pictorial content, capturing the feel of a collection of ephemera from an earlier historical period.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Bartholomew; The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in motion. The drawing features dynamic sketches depicting figures engaged in various actions. In the upper section, the figures are engaged in a collaborative activity, with some bent over and others standing. The figures are outlined with fluid lines conveying motion. In the lower portion, more figures are engaged in a different scene, characterized by swirling lines and contorted poses suggesting movement or struggle. The scene explores human form and movement through sketching techniques.

artworks.title: Studies of Christ Healing the Blind Man, Saint Philip Benizzi, and Saint Sebastian
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures and scenes. The drawing consists of several distinct figures depicted in different actions and postures. The prominent figure is a muscular man bent over, possibly examining or holding something small. Around him are other figures, some standing and some kneeling, with their forms abstract or only partially detailed. The outlines and strokes suggest a quick, exploratory sketch rather than a detailed finished drawing, capturing movement and spontaneity. There are hints of interaction among the figures, creating a dynamic and flowing composition.

artworks.title: A Diplomatic (Chinese) Design Presented to U.S.
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on newsprint
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dragon coiled around an elaborate vase. The vase features intricate designs and scenes, including figures and symbols, with the dragon clutching a piece of paper labelled "U.S. TREATY." The setting evokes a sense of cultural diplomacy or negotiation. The illustration contains a variety of elements that seem to portray a blend of Eastern and Western motifs, with a focus on the ornate style of the vase's artwork and the powerful presence of the dragon. The drawing is detailed with an ink rendering, conveying a sense of intricate craftsmanship both in the depiction of the mythical creature and the decoratively illustrated vase.

artworks.title: King Death's Distribution of Prizes. Bacchus Takes the First Premium.
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on newsprint
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a crowned skeleton giving a prize to a figure representing Bacchus in a setting called "The Court of Death." The crowned skeleton hands a prize to Bacchus, who is adorned with ivy leaves and holds an emblem. Shadowy figures observe the scene, with a scroll on the ground noting Bacchus as the first premium winner. The image portrays a darkly satirical take on indulgence, mortality, and possibly includes social commentary of the late 19th-century editorial illustrations.

artworks.title: The Angel Appearing to Hagar in the Desert
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows swirling and curving lines drawn in red chalk on a textured background. The lines form loose shapes intertwined throughout the page. At certain points, the lines converge to suggest faint outlines of human figures, resembling angels or figures in motion. The artwork uses abstract lines and shading to hint at dynamic movement and ethereal shapes.

artworks.title: An Allegory of Truth and Falsehood (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash (verso)
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a mountain with a temple built into it. The image depicts multiple figures clustered in groups, some in motion or engaged in activity. In the background, a large mountain rises with a temple-like structure at its base. At the mountain's peak, a figure is depicted in a seated position, gesturing or addressing the assembly below. The drawing utilizes a monochromatic palette of browns and blacks, creating a somber and dramatic effect. The lines are loose and sketchy, conveying movement and energy. The figures appear to be interacting with each other, some bending or kneeling, while others are standing.

artworks.title: Studies of Figures (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of human-like figures in various dynamic poses. The figures are engaged in activities such as walking, holding objects, reclining, and other poses. The style is a study of the human form, with sketch-like brush strokes and varying intensities, giving a sense of movement. The drawing has a rough texture with visible shading practices, possibly indicating exploration of anatomy and pose. The background is plain, emphasizing the sketches, which are drawn in brownish ink or pigment, contributing to an aged aesthetic.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: cliché-verre in wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the title page for "Dramen" by Max Klinger. The image features black and white linework that surrounds a central rectangular area with text. Above this text, a scene shows a winged figure atop a pillar, while other figures interact with swirling lines. Below, the composition includes remnants of classical architecture and a backdrop of nature. The text is presented in a classical serif font, and the title "DRAMEN" is highlighted in a bold, red typeface.

artworks.title: Eine Mutter I (A Mother I)
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view of an urban alleyway between aged buildings. The perspective is slightly elevated, allowing an above and side view. To the right, a group of people are on a small balcony attached to a building. The closely spaced structures obscure the horizon. Rooftops and chimneys add to the busy feel. In the background, distant building peaks are visible. The artwork uses etched lines for texture and cross-hatching for depth and shadow. The color scheme is monochromatic with browns and grays. The sky is mottled, contrasting with the architectural details below.

artworks.title: Eine Mutter II (A Mother II)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dock scene. The image shows a waterfront with figures on a staircase leading up to a building. In the lower portion are figures by a small boat and one figure lying flat on a platform over the water. The water reflects light and shadows. There is a labeled façade in the background. The drawing is done in an etching technique, with fine lines and hatching for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Eine Mutter III (A Mother III)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures sitting around a table in a dimly lit room. The room is illuminated by pendant lights hanging from the ceiling, casting shadows. The walls are adorned with details and side lamps are visible. The figures appear engaged in a serious discussion or presentation, with documents and possibly books on the table.

artworks.title: Ein Mord (A Murder)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people by a crowded dockside area next to a river or canal. The individuals are engaged in different activities. There is a bridge overhead and a large building with a chimney in the background. A moored boat is to the right. The scene portrays a lively waterfront in a historical setting.

artworks.title: Pan Reclining before a Herm
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Purchased as the Gift of Robert B. Loper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with classical sculptures and figures. The drawing features an arrangement of classical elements, including a statue on a pedestal in a wooded setting, flanked by large urns and surrounded by draped figures in leisurely poses. Dense foliage frames the composition, providing a sense of depth and a natural backdrop. The chiaroscuro effect highlights the intricate details of the figures and objects such as the ornate designs on the urns and the textured bark of the trees. The style is reminiscent of classical pastoral themes, focusing on relaxation and the eternal beauty of ancient forms.
